description: This file defines the API endpoint class `LeaveTypeAPI` for managing Leave Types within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting leave type records. The class uses various traits, models, and validation rules to enable RESTful interactions and enforce data integrity and authorization. It is a key component in the Leave plugin module, specific to leave type management within the HRM system.
